name: Joseph Manacmul
office: Downey Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 7

items.text: Joseph Manacmul represents Trustee Area 7 on the Downey Unified School District Board of Education. He was appointed in October 2025 to fill a vacancy caused by the death of a trustee. He graduated from UCLA and earned a master’s degree in public policy from Pepperdine University. According to his campaign, he helped build Stay Arts, a nonprofit that offered arts and public programming. In a candidate questionnaire, he said his priorities include strong reading and math instruction, early intervention, student wellness, and opportunities that prepare students for success beyond graduation. He also stated he delivered Measure K under budget as principal officer and would focus on protecting classroom resources and making transparent, responsible investments.
